components.name: Link
components.description: Takes the reader somewhere else. It sits in running text and is set like the words around it, so a long label wraps across lines with its paragraph and its icon stays with the last word. `standalone` takes it out of the text, as a line of its own under a teaser; its label and icon still wrap the same way inside it.

icon.description: Says where the link goes, such as an arrow or a mark for another site. It follows the label and never ends up alone on a line.

components.name: LinkLabel
components.description: The words that say where the link goes.
